brief.title: UK training-provider prospects for Veltadoc
brief.description: One free researched training-provider profile and five additional UK training-provider profiles, each with a published business contact route, observed certificate workflow, original sources, proposed batch-generation use and tailored opening.
brief.exclusions: Use the provider's own attendance, participation or completion documents and preserve its approval step. Confirm current preparation workflow and whether a batch approach adds value; actual demand is established through the conversation.

input.operator_note: Original Veltadoc case C0BTTA66TK3 /1791868549.605979. Complete customer research and files for additive receiving into the existing larger workspace. Customer first-contact ownership remains 379A.

leads.demand: The 2.5-hour Basic Barista Course includes a participation certificate. The course page says certificates are posted the following week and publishes reservation dates and a direct email.
leads.fit: After the tutor confirms attendance, the class roster could populate a batch of the school's own participation certificates, with a staff review before the existing print-and-post step.
leads.opening_message: Hi BARistaBARBAR team — your Basic Barista Course page says participation certificates are posted the following week. Would a short example of preparing a class's print-ready certificates from one spreadsheet be useful? You would keep your current wording and approve attendance before generating the batch.
leads.status_note: Discuss the school's own Basic Course participation certificate. Preserve its existing wording, approval and postal process; establish current batch preparation and whether a reusable CSV mapping would help.
leads.operator_note: Priority 1. Training administration. Current process: Reservations are accepted through the published email, Eventbrite or PayPal; students register on arrival. Proposed demonstration: Three fictional attendees with name, course and completion date, mapped to an approved participation-certificate layout; check spelling, long names and the print output. Additional sources:

leads.demand: The school explicitly offers its own skills-based courses with a completion certificate. Its one-day Barista Beginner Masterclass runs at Wandsworth and collects each student's name and email when booking.
leads.fit: A confirmed class roster could produce the school's own completion certificates in one batch, reusing the mapping and approved school branding for later dates.
leads.opening_message: Hi London School of Coffee team — I saw that your own skills-based courses include a completion certificate, and the Beginner Masterclass already collects each student's name. Would a small example of turning a completed class roster into branded certificates help your course administration? It can use fictional attendees and your approved wording.
leads.status_note: Select an own-school skills course such as the Beginner Masterclass. Keep any SCA exam, approval and issuing systems with their existing authority; confirm the actual school certificate workflow and export format.
leads.operator_note: Priority 2. Course administration. Current process: The Beginner Masterclass uses dated bookings and named student fields. Proposed demonstration: A fictional Beginner Masterclass roster with name, course and completion date, reviewed by the operator before producing the school's own documents. Additional sources: https://londonschoolofcoffee.com/collections/non-sca-skills-based-courses-lsc/products/lsc-basic-barista

leads.demand: The company offers barista training to its wholesale customers and includes a participation certificate on completion.
leads.fit: A completed wholesale customer's training roster could become a batch of participation PDFs with consistent company branding, ready for staff review and the chosen delivery method.
leads.contact_instructions: published general business email; office phone and contact form also available. Contact source: https://coffee-company.co.uk/privacy-policy/
leads.opening_message: Hi Coffee Company team — your wholesale barista training includes a participation certificate. Would a short roster-to-certificate example help the person who prepares those after a training session? You could keep your own wording and review the whole batch before sending or printing it.
leads.status_note: Confirm the current training schedule and certificate preparation process. A general published business address is available in its own privacy page; the current contact form and office phone are alternative routes.
leads.operator_note: Priority 3. Training coordination. Current process: Training is arranged through the company; the contact page provides its Newton Abbot office number and a general inquiry form. Proposed demonstration: A fictional group of three wholesale-customer trainees, using confirmed completion fields and the provider's approved participation wording. Additional sources: https://coffee-company.co.uk/contact-us/ https://coffee-company.co.uk/about-the-coffee-company/

leads.demand: Its ten-week fast-track floristry evening course runs through the year, is limited to eight students, and awards a completion certificate. Jill Woodall is the named teacher and founder.
leads.fit: A small cohort's completion certificates could be generated together from an approved student list, with reusable names/course/date mapping for each term.
leads.opening_message: Hi Jill — I saw that your ten-week floristry course finishes with a completion certificate for each student. Would a brief example of preparing a term's certificates from one list be useful? The sample can use fictional names and retain your wording and visual identity.
leads.status_note: Use the published business phone to introduce the specific workflow. Establish whether the small cohort size makes the batch step worthwhile and keep tutor approval of completion in place.
leads.operator_note: Priority 4. Founder and teacher. Current process: The course page directs private-training inquiries to Jill; the school's contact page publishes her telephone and studio address. Proposed demonstration: A fictional eight-student term list with the approved course name and completion date; inspect long names and every certificate before delivery. Additional sources: https://www.bristolflowerschool.co.uk/about/

leads.organization: The Shoreditch Academy of Image Making
leads.demand: The academy runs a physical four-hour Cyanotype On Glass workshop for up to ten people, using a classroom and darkroom. The course outcome explicitly includes the academy's certificate of attendance and a digital badge. Its current course page offers dates by arrangement and publishes the course-inquiry email.
leads.fit: A small, tutor-approved attendance list is a practical demonstration input for producing one branded PDF per attendee. Keep the existing academy wording and badge process; compare name placement, course title/date and per-person export against the current certificate.
leads.opening_message: Your Cyanotype On Glass workshop includes an attendance certificate for a small studio group. Would a preview using your current certificate layout and a few example attendee names help you assess whether Veltadoc could simplify preparation after each class?
leads.status_note: Confirm the course administrator's current template, required wording and preferred handoff format. The instructor still confirms attendance. Ask about the next arranged cohort rather than assuming a fixed date. The inquiry body publishes the complete hello@theshoreditchacademy.com address; a later FAQ line contains a formatting error, so use the clear inquiry contact.
leads.operator_note: Priority 5. Published course inquiry contact. Current process: The own attendance certificate follows a hands-on workshop. The public page does not identify the software used to prepare or distribute it. Proposed demonstration: A small, tutor-approved attendance list is a practical demonstration input for producing one branded PDF per attendee. Keep the existing academy wording and badge process; compare name placement, course title/date and per-person export against the current certificate. Additional sources:

leads.demand: Photoion's official FAQ states that students can request a certificate after completing any of its courses or workshops, through the tutor or school. The live Digital Photography Level2 course is taught in person over two days, with groups limited to eight. The school publishes its business email and Waterloo studio address.
leads.fit: An on-request certificate workflow fits a small named batch or a single replacement PDF. Demonstrate the current Photoion template with sample names, course/date fields and individual downloads, then compare it with the team's present preparation process.
leads.opening_message: Your FAQ offers completion certificates when a learner asks the tutor or school. Would a preview of your current certificate with sample Level2 attendee names be useful for comparing how a single request or a small class batch is prepared?
leads.status_note: Confirm whether certificates are issued locally by Photoion or centrally through City Academy, plus the current template and completion approval. Keep the pilot limited to the provider's existing own-course certificate. The current course has small physical classes; certificate software and its current workload are not public.
leads.operator_note: Priority 6. Published school contact. Current process: Own course/workshop completion certificates are available on request to a tutor or the school. The live storefront identifies Photoion as part of City Academy; keep that affiliation when reaching the appropriate course administrator. Proposed demonstration: An on-request certificate workflow fits a small named batch or a single replacement PDF. Demonstrate the current Photoion template with sample names, course/date fields and individual downloads, then compare it with the team's present preparation process. Additional sources: https://www.photoion.co.uk/courses/intermediate-photography-course-london/
